standard.name: ISO 42001
standard.description: Artificial Intelligence Management System - Requirements with Guidance for Use

categories.name: AI Management System Requirements
categories.description: Requirements for responsible AI system development, deployment, and operation

clauses.title: Context of the Organization
clauses.description: Understanding organizational context, legal requirements, policies, cultural factors, and competitive landscape affecting AI management
clauses.helpText: Analyze AI-specific context including regulatory environment (EU AI Act, etc.)

clauses.title: Understanding the organization and its context
clauses.description: Determine internal and external issues relevant to AI management system
clauses.helpText: AI regulatory landscape, ethical considerations, stakeholder concerns

clauses.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
clauses.description: Identify interested parties and their AI-related requirements and expectations
clauses.helpText: Stakeholders: users, regulators, affected individuals, AI ethics board

clauses.title: Determining the scope of the AI management system
clauses.description: Define boundaries and applicability of AI management system
clauses.helpText: Which AI systems are in scope, organizational boundaries, exclusions

clauses.title: Artificial intelligence management system
clauses.description: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve AI management system
clauses.helpText: AIMS framework including policies, processes, and controls

clauses.title: Leadership
clauses.description: Top management demonstrates leadership, establishes AI policy and objectives, provides resources, promotes continual improvement
clauses.helpText: Executive accountability for responsible AI

clauses.title: Leadership and commitment
clauses.description: Top management accountability for effectiveness of AI management system
clauses.helpText: AI governance structure, executive sponsorship, resource allocation

clauses.title: Policy
clauses.description: Establish AI policy compatible with strategic direction, framework for AI objectives
clauses.helpText: AI ethics policy, responsible AI principles, fairness and transparency commitments

clauses.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
clauses.description: Assign and communicate AI-related roles, responsibilities and authorities
clauses.helpText: AI governance committee, AI ethics officer, data scientist roles, accountability

clauses.title: Planning
clauses.description: Identify AI risks and opportunities, set AI objectives, plan to achieve them
clauses.helpText: AI risk assessment and treatment planning

clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
clauses.description: AI risk assessment and AI risk treatment planning
clauses.helpText: AI-specific risks: bias, fairness, transparency, privacy, security, safety

clauses.title: AI objectives and planning to achieve them
clauses.description: Establish AI objectives at relevant functions and levels, plan how to achieve them
clauses.helpText: Objectives for AI fairness, explainability, performance, compliance

clauses.title: Support
clauses.description: Resources, competence, awareness, communication, documented information for AI management system
clauses.helpText: AI expertise, tools, infrastructure, and documentation

clauses.title: Resources
clauses.description: Determine and provide resources needed for AI management system
clauses.helpText: Computing resources, AI tools, data infrastructure, personnel

clauses.title: Competence
clauses.description: Ensure competence of persons affecting AI system performance
clauses.helpText: AI/ML expertise, data science skills, AI ethics training

clauses.title: Awareness
clauses.description: Ensure awareness of AI policy, objectives, contribution, and implications
clauses.helpText: AI awareness training, responsible AI principles communication

clauses.title: Communication
clauses.description: Determine internal and external AI-related communications
clauses.helpText: Communication about AI use, transparency disclosures, stakeholder engagement

clauses.title: Documented information
clauses.description: AIMS includes documented information required by standard and determined necessary
clauses.helpText: AI model documentation, data lineage, algorithm cards, impact assessments

clauses.title: Operation
clauses.description: Operational planning, AI risk assessment, AI risk treatment, AI system impact assessment, AI lifecycle management
clauses.helpText: AI development, deployment, and operational controls

clauses.title: Operational planning and control
clauses.description: Plan, implement and control processes needed to meet AI management requirements
clauses.helpText: AI development lifecycle processes, controls at each stage

clauses.title: AI risk assessment
clauses.description: Conduct AI risk assessments for AI systems
clauses.helpText: Assess risks: bias, fairness, privacy, security, safety, explainability

clauses.title: AI risk treatment
clauses.description: Implement AI risk treatment plans to mitigate identified risks
clauses.helpText: Controls for bias mitigation, fairness testing, explainability mechanisms

clauses.title: AI system impact assessment
clauses.description: Perform impact assessments for AI systems
clauses.helpText: Impact on individuals, society, environment, human rights

clauses.title: Data management
clauses.description: Manage data throughout AI system lifecycle from design to deployment and maintenance
clauses.helpText: Data quality, data governance, data lineage, data privacy controls

clauses.title: Performance Evaluation
clauses.description: Monitor, measure, analyze and evaluate AI management system performance, conduct audits and management reviews
clauses.helpText: AI model performance monitoring, fairness metrics, compliance monitoring

clauses.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
clauses.description: Determine what to monitor/measure for AI systems, methods, when, how to analyze
clauses.helpText: AI model performance metrics, bias metrics, drift detection, user feedback

clauses.title: Internal audit
clauses.description: Conduct internal audits to determine AIMS conformity and effectiveness
clauses.helpText: AI governance audits, algorithmic audits, compliance audits

clauses.title: Management review
clauses.description: Review AIMS at planned intervals for suitability, adequacy, effectiveness
clauses.helpText: Review AI performance, incidents, regulatory changes, stakeholder feedback

clauses.title: Improvement
clauses.description: Continual improvement of AIMS, handle nonconformities, implement corrective actions
clauses.helpText: Continuous improvement of AI governance and responsible AI practices

clauses.title: General
clauses.description: Determine and select opportunities for improvement
clauses.helpText: Improvement initiatives for AI fairness, transparency, performance

clauses.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
clauses.description: React to nonconformities, investigate, take action, review effectiveness
clauses.helpText: AI incident response, bias incidents, model failures, corrective actions

clauses.title: Continual improvement
clauses.description: Continually improve suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of AIMS
clauses.helpText: Regular enhancement of AI governance maturity and responsible AI practices
